messages.author: 77cdfc95cafe04b9
messages.subject: Error in gl.fst.pop function
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to calculate the Fst values from my dataset, however the software returns the following warning message:

fst<-gl.fst.pop(gl_Neut2, nboots=2, percent=95, nclusters = 1) 

Error in makePSOCKcluster(names = spec, ...) :
Cluster setup failed. 1 worker of 1 failed to connect.

Have you face with the same trouble before?, thanks in advance for your reply.
Cheers

Pablo

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Error in gl.fst.pop function
parts:
Hi Pablo,

A first step would be to update R, Rstudio and all your packages.

1. Here is a nice tutorial to update R and R-studio:

 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/3-methods-update-r-rstudio-windows-mac-woratana-ngarmtrakulchol 

2. To update all your packages, you can type in the R console:

> update.packages(ask = F)

3. Re-install dartR:

> install.packages("dartR")

And then try again your code.

If that doesn't' solve your problem, you can look at one possible solution at:

https://github.com/rstudio/rstudio/issues/6692#issuecomment-619645114


Cheers,

Luis
